mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_initialization (id, tenant_id, service, status, error, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{service}, #{status}, #{error}, now(), now(), NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, service) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, error = EXCLUDED.error, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL
